name: Inês Carvalho
summary: UX/UI designer with 4 years of experience designing web and mobile products for fintech, e-commerce and agency clients. Works end to end from discovery interviews and journey mapping to high-fidelity UI in Figma and usability testing, and has owned a shared design system used by four product squads. Comfortable working remotely across European time zones. Native Portuguese, fluent English (C1). Portuguese citizen (EU).

experience.description: Lead designer for onboarding and card management flows of a consumer payments app (~300,000 MAU). Built and maintains the Figma design system (120+ components, design tokens) used by 4 squads. Ran 30+ moderated usability sessions and 6 discovery interview rounds. Redesigned KYC onboarding, cutting drop-off from 38% to 24%. Brought core flows to WCAG 2.1 AA. Works with front-end engineers on handoff and Storybook parity.

Designed web and mobile products for 8 agency clients in retail, travel and education, from discovery workshops to launch. Wireframes, prototypes and final UI for an e-commerce checkout that lifted conversion 11%. Facilitated design sprints and workshops in English with UK, Dutch and Brazilian clients. Set up a reusable starter UI kit.
Designed screens and marketing landing pages for SaaS clients, supported senior designers with icons, illustrations and responsive layouts, and prepared developer specifications.
